errors.evidence: The chart shows 28 bars, representing 28 countries, not 27.
The countries on the horizontal axis are sorted in descending order of their corresponding values, not alphabetically.
The vertical axis is not labeled at all. The description incorrectly states that it is labeled as having no units.
The range of the vertical axis is from 0.0000 to 1.0000, not from 0.1000.
The highest value, for the Netherlands, is approximately 0.91, which is significantly lower than the stated 0.9500.
The lowest value, for Romania, is approximately 0.61, which is significantly lower than the stated 0.7000.

errors.text_span: Повечето стълби са с височина между 0,7000 и 0,8500.
errors.evidence: While many bars fall within this range, they do not constitute a majority ("повечето") of the 28 bars shown.

errors.text_span: Някои от стълбите са групирани заедно
errors.evidence: The term "групирани" (grouped) is misleading, as it typically refers to a grouped bar chart structure. The description uses it to refer to visual clustering, which can cause confusion.

errors.text_span: Обединеното кралство имат по-високи стойности на EGDI над 0,9000
errors.evidence: The bar for the United Kingdom ("Обединено...") is clearly below the 0.9000 mark, at approximately 0.89.
